title: Compliance control-mapping registry
description: Validates your compliance configuration directory's control-mapping registry — the policy-data registry that pre-classifies every in-scope control (deterministic / evidence_review / organizational) and defines deterministic checks as DECLARATIVE ASSERTION RECORDS evaluated by the assertion evaluator (determinism amendment 2: checks are diffable data, not per-check code). The LLM never classifies a control or authors an assertion at run time — changing either is a reviewed config change.

checks.description: check ids — REQUIRED non-empty when classification=deterministic

evidence_request.description: evidence_review controls: what human-supplied artifact the agent judges

crosswalk.description: hand-authored framework:control_id tags (e.g. 'nist-800-53-rev5:ia-2.1') — never vendored from restricted mappings

applicability.description: declared not_applicable condition (amendment 4) — evaluated over the snapshot; false ⇒ not_applicable, never narrated

parameters.description: org-parameter ids this control's checks consume; any undeclared ⇒ not_assessed(parameter undeclared)

collector.description: snapshot kind this check reads (scan_k8s_hardening | run_gitleaks | run_osv_scanner | run_govulncheck | cloud_inventory | sbom | cosign)

sampling.description: REQUIRED if the check does not evaluate ALL selected values: a deterministic rule ('sorted_first_50') — 'representative' is not expressible (amendment 7)

fixtures.description: path to the known-bad/known-good fixture pair (Phase 4 admission gate)

parameter_refs.description: org-parameter ids whose values the assertion's `expected` resolves from ('param:<id>')

path.description: dot path into the canonical snapshot; [*] fans out — the assertion must hold for EVERY selected value (no sampling unless `sampling` is declared)

expected.description: literal, or 'param:<org-parameter-id>' resolved from org-parameters.yaml at evaluation time
